最近硅谷两大佬因为马斯克吵翻了，结果老马亲自下场，一句话把全网看乐了。

先是著名反垄断评论家 Matt 泼冷水：SpaceX 算什么奇迹？马斯克根本不是天才，无非是会找华尔街搞钱，用钞票和工程师硬堆出来的。

这话连平时谁都不服的硅谷传奇程序员 DHH 都看不下去了，直接回怼：太酸了！哪怕你不喜欢马斯克，也得承认他“把吹过的牛变成现实”的能力举世无双。从特斯拉、脑机接口到 SpaceX，世上有一百万个会搞钱的投资人，但只有一个马斯克。

随后马斯克本尊下场，只回了一句灵魂反问：“行，那你给我解释一下蓝色起源、波音和 ULA？”

这一刀，直接捅在了“唯金钱论”的肺管子上。

如果光靠砸钱就能上天，那现在的太空霸主绝不可能是 SpaceX：
1、 比谁更有钱？ 贝索斯的蓝色起源比 SpaceX 早成立两年，背后站着前世界首富，从来不缺钱，结果到现在还在努力追赶。

name: TC
description: TC (TURK) is a community-driven meme token launched on Solana, inspired by the Turkchain® blockchain ecosystem. Turkchain® Mainnet (Chain ID: 1919) is an independent EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain with TURK as its native currency. TC (TURK) on Solana is a separate token and is not currently the native TURK coin of Turkchain® Mainnet. Once the Solana ↔ Turkchain® cross-chain bridge is officially activated**, eligible TC (TURK) Meme Token holders will be entitled to exchange their tokens for native TURK on Turkchain® Mainnet at a 1:1 ratio For every 1 eligible TC (TURK) token held, users will be able to claim 1 native TURK through the official bridge, subject to the published eligibility requirements, available reserves, and bridge conditions. Built for community engagement, cross-chain connectivity, and the spirit of Web3. From Solana to Turkchain® — One Community, Two Networks.
